desc.en: ¬a: true in gives false out; false in gives true out.
desc.zh: ¬a：输入是真，输出假；输入是假，输出真。

desc.en: a ∧ b: outputs true only when both inputs are true; otherwise false.
desc.zh: a ∧ b：两个输入都是真，才输出真；否则输出假。

desc.en: From A → B and A, gives B.
desc.zh: 由 A → B 和 A 得到 B。

desc.en: A box, with A set on the part. Inside, A may be used as an assumption; prove B there and wire it to “Conclusion”, and the part gives A → B.
desc.zh: 带一个框，A 在元件上设定。框内可以使用假设 A；框内证出 B 并接到「结论」，元件输出 A → B。

desc.en: Connect A and B to get A ∧ B.
desc.zh: 接入 A 和 B，得到 A ∧ B。

desc.en: Connect A ∧ B to get A and B at separate outputs.
desc.zh: 接入 A ∧ B，两个输出口分别得到 A 和 B。

desc.en: Connect A and choose another statement B and its position to get A ∨ B or B ∨ A. B need not be proved.
desc.zh: 接入 A，选定另一句 B 和它的位置，得到 A ∨ B 或 B ∨ A；不需要证明 B。

desc.en: Connect A ∨ B and assume A and B in separate boxes. When both prove the same C and connect it to their respective “Conclusion” ports, the part outputs C.
desc.zh: 接入 A ∨ B，在两个框中分别假设 A、B。两个框都证出同一句 C 并接到各自的「结论」时，元件输出 C。

desc.en: From the contradiction ⊥, gives whatever sentence is chosen on the part.
desc.zh: 由矛盾 ⊥ 得到元件上选定的任意一句。

desc.en: From ¬¬A, gives A (double-negation elimination).
desc.zh: 由 ¬¬A 得到 A（双重否定消去）。

desc.en: Name an arbitrary object a on the part. Prove P(a) inside the box and connect it to “Conclusion” to obtain ∀x. P(x) outside. a must not occur in any open assumption.
desc.zh: 在元件上为任意对象取名 a，在框内证明 P(a) 并接到「结论」，框外得到 ∀x. P(x)。a 不能出现在未解除的假设中。

desc.en: Connect ∀x. P(x) and choose an object t to obtain P(t).
desc.zh: 接入 ∀x. P(x)，选定对象 t，得到 P(t)。

desc.en: Connect P(t) to obtain ∃x. P(x), with t as a witness. If exactly one existential statement fits, it is selected automatically; if several fit, choose the conclusion on the part.
desc.zh: 接入 P(t)，以 t 为例得到 ∃x. P(x)。只有一个相符的存在命题时自动输出；有多个时，在元件上选择要得出的命题。

desc.en: Connect ∃x. P(x) and name the existing object a on the part. Inside the box, P(a) may be assumed. Prove C and connect it to “Conclusion” to obtain C outside. a must not appear in C or in any open assumption.
desc.zh: 接入 ∃x. P(x)，在元件上为存在的对象取名 a。框内可以假设 P(a)；证出 C 并接到「结论」后，框外得到 C。C 中不能出现 a，a 也不能出现在未解除的假设中。

desc.en: Two boxes, proving the ∀x. P(x) chosen on the part. The first proves P(0); in the second the number is called a (named on the part; it must not occur in any open assumption), P(a) may be used as an assumption, and P(S a) is to be proved. Once both are proved, the part gives ∀x. P(x).
desc.zh: 带两个框，证元件上选定的 ∀x. P(x)。第一个框证 P(0)；第二个框内的数记作 a（在元件上命名，不能出现在未解除的假设中），可以使用假设 P(a)，要证 P(S a)。两个框都证完，元件输出 ∀x. P(x)。

label.zh: 从 a 到 S a

desc.en: Choose a thing t on the part; gives t = t.
desc.zh: 在元件上选定一样东西 t，得到 t = t。

desc.en: Wire in s = t and a sentence containing s; the part marks each s in it, and the ticked ones become t.
desc.zh: 接入 s = t 和一句含 s 的话；元件标出这句话里的每一处 s，勾选的几处换成 t。

desc.en: Gives ?R: any sentence at all.
desc.zh: 输出 ?R：任意一句话。

desc.en: Wire in a rule and a sentence: keeps the rule’s premises and makes the sentence its conclusion.
desc.zh: 接入一条规则和一句话：保留规则的前提，结论换成这句话。

desc.en: Puts “This” at the front of “A list”; when what comes into “A list” is not a list, makes a list of the two.
desc.zh: 把「这一样」放在「一串」的最前面；「一串」接入的不是列表时，把两者组成一个列表。

desc.en: Builds the rule ⟦premises⟧ ⟹ conclusion from premises (a list or a single item) and a conclusion. A sentence is a premise as it is; a rule becomes a premise with its own assumptions.
desc.zh: 由前提（列表或单项）和结论构造规则 ⟦前提⟧ ⟹ 结论。句子直接作为前提；规则成为带自身假设的前提。

desc.en: Wire in a list: the frame receives one item at a time, and its inner output goes to “Result”; each item is processed once, and the results form a list in the original order.
desc.zh: 接入列表：框每次收到其中一项，框内的输出接到「结果」；每一项处理一次，结果按原顺序组成列表。

desc.en: Wire in a rule. If it begins with bound variables (⋀x. …), the frame works on the rule after them, and the output keeps the same bound variables in front; if it has none, the frame works on the input itself.
desc.zh: 接入一条规则。规则以约束变量开头（⋀x. …）时，框内处理其后的规则，输出时在结果前保留这些约束变量；没有约束变量时，框内直接处理输入。

label.en: The rule after the bound variables

desc.en: Finds an equation with identical sides, t ≐ t, and deletes it.
desc.zh: 找到两边相同的等式 t ≐ t，删去它。

desc.en: Finds an equation whose sides have the same structure (both “and”, the same predicate …) and splits it into equations between corresponding parts: ?A ∧ ?B ≐ it rains ∧ it is windy becomes ?A ≐ it rains and ?B ≐ it is windy. ¬A splits as A → ⊥.
desc.zh: 找到两边结构相同的等式（都是「并且」、都是同一个谓词……），分解为对应部分之间的等式：?A ∧ ?B ≐ 下雨 ∧ 刮风 分解为 ?A ≐ 下雨 和 ?B ≐ 刮风。¬A 按 A → ⊥ 分解。

desc.en: Finds an equation with no ?-letter on either side and different structures (an “and” against an “or”, two different sentences …) and reports failure.
desc.zh: 找到两边都不是 ?-字母、结构却不同的等式（一边是「并且」一边是「或者」，或是两个不同的句子……），报告失败。

desc.en: Finds an equation with a ?-letter on the right only, t ≐ ?A, and turns it into ?A ≐ t.
desc.zh: 找到只有右边是 ?-字母的等式 t ≐ ?A，改写为 ?A ≐ t。

desc.en: Finds ?A ≐ t where t contains ?A and is not ?A itself, and reports failure.
desc.zh: 找到等式 ?A ≐ t，t 含有 ?A 而不是 ?A 本身时，报告失败。

desc.en: Finds ?A ≐ t (t free of ?A) where ?A still occurs in other equations, and replaces ?A with t there.
desc.zh: 找到等式 ?A ≐ t（t 不含 ?A），而 ?A 还出现在其他等式中：把那些等式中的 ?A 全部换成 t。

desc.en: Finds ⋀x. ?P(x) ≐ t where ?P is applied to distinct variables bound by the ⋀ and t contains no other ⋀ variable, and solves ?P ≐ fun x => t. When ?P is applied to anything else (?P(ann), ?P(?t)), the equation is left unchanged.
desc.zh: 找到等式 ⋀x. ?P(x) ≐ t：?P 的参数是受 ⋀ 约束、互不相同的变量，t 中没有其他 ⋀ 变量。解出 ?P ≐ fun x => t。?P 的参数不是这样的变量时（?P(安)、?P(?t)），保留原等式不变。

desc.en: The frame receives the input; its inner output goes to “Result” and back into the frame, round after round, until it stops changing, and the last round’s result is given. If a round fails, it stops at the round before.
desc.zh: 框收到输入，框内的输出接到「结果」后再送回框内，逐轮重复，直到结果不再变化，输出最后一轮的结果；某一轮失败时，停在失败前的一轮。

desc.en: Takes rules at its “Rules” port and uses the first that applies: the first goal is unified with the rule’s conclusion and replaced by its premises (one goal per premise, each premise’s own assumptions added to the hypotheses). Any ?-letter not yet fixed stays in the goals.
desc.zh: 从「规则」口接入规则，用第一条适用的：第一个目标与规则的结论合一，换成规则的前提（每条前提一个目标，前提自带的假设加入已知）。尚未确定的 ?-字母留在目标中。

desc.en: Unifies the first goal with one of its hypotheses: on success the goal is closed and its ?-letters are fixed. It searches from the top and uses the first that fits.
desc.zh: 第一个目标与它的一条已知合一：成功时这个目标证完，相应的 ?-字母随之确定。从上往下查找，用第一条合得上的已知。

desc.en: Moves the first goal to the end; the second becomes the first.
desc.zh: 把第一个目标移到最后，原来的第二个目标成为第一个。

desc.en: Every region receives the same state; gives the result of the first region that does not fail. The number of regions is chosen on the part.
desc.zh: 每个框收到相同的状态；输出第一个没有失败的框的结果。在元件上选定框的数目。

desc.en: Depth-first search: the parts inside take one step on the state received, then go on from each result; each path is followed to its end before backtracking to the next, until no goal remains. Gives every finished state it finds. A step back to where it was (no fewer goals, no more hypotheses) is not followed. A depth limit can be set on the part.
desc.zh: 深度优先搜索：框内的元件对收到的状态走一步，再从得到的每种结果继续；一条路走到底再回溯走下一条，直到没有目标。输出找到的每一个证完的状态。回到原状态的一步（目标没有减少，已知也没有增加）不再继续。可以在元件上设定最大深度。

desc.en: The parts inside run once on each goal, seeing only that goal each time; if any goal fails, the whole part fails.
desc.zh: 框内的元件对每个目标各执行一次，每次只看到这一个目标；任一目标失败，整个元件失败。

desc.en: Takes rewrite rules: in the first goal, outside in and left to right, the first place that fits the rule’s left side becomes its right side, that place alone. A rule with conditions adds each as a new goal after this one. Given several, it uses the first that fits; if nothing fits, it fails.
desc.zh: 接入改写规则：在第一个目标中，由外向内、从左到右找到第一处与规则左边相合的位置，换成规则右边，只换这一处。规则带条件时，每个条件成为新目标，排在这个目标之后。接入多条时用第一条相合的；没有一处相合，元件失败。

desc.en: Removes every ∃ from the first goal’s hypotheses: one with no ∀ outside is taken out as the instance box does; one under a ∀ becomes a new function of all the enclosing ∀ variables (sk1(x) …). The hypotheses must be in negation normal form first.
desc.zh: 消去第一个目标的已知中所有的 ∃：外层没有 ∀ 的，像实例框一样取出那一样东西；在 ∀ 之内的，换成一个新函数，参数是外层所有 ∀ 的变量（sk1(x)……）。已知须先化为否定范式。

desc.en: The first goal must be ⊥: its hypotheses are split into clauses. Each must be in CNF; conjunctions are split, each disjunction becomes a clause, ∀s are dropped and variables read as universally quantified.
desc.zh: 第一个目标须为 ⊥：把它的已知拆成子句。每条已知须为合取范式；拆开「并且」，每串「或者」成为一条子句，去掉 ∀，变量按「对所有」理解。

desc.en: Tries every pair of clauses in the set once: when a literal of one unifies with the complement of a literal of the other, that pair is cancelled and the remaining literals form a new clause, added with a record of its two parents. Tautologies and duplicates are dropped. It can be set to resolve only against one-literal clauses.
desc.zh: 子句集中的每一对子句各试一次：一条中的某个文字与另一条中的相反文字能合一时，消去这一对，其余文字合成新子句加入子句集，并记下它的两条父子句。舍弃永真子句和重复子句。可以在元件上设定只与单文字子句归结。

desc.en: A fast prover: it cancels all complementary literals between two clauses at once, round after round until ⊥ appears or no new clause does. It too records the two parents of each new clause.
desc.zh: 快速证明器：两条子句间的相反文字一次全部消去，逐轮进行，直到推出 ⊥ 或不再产生新子句。每条新子句也记下两条父子句。

desc.en: When the clause set contains ⊥, the steps to ⊥ go to the kernel: each input clause used must come from a hypothesis, and each step must be proved from its two parents (variables instantiated by unification) by Own auto. If all pass, the goal the clauses came from is proved; otherwise it names the failing step.
desc.zh: 子句集中有 ⊥ 时，把推出 ⊥ 的步骤交给核检查：用到的每条输入子句须由某条已知拆出；每一步须由它的两条父子句（变量按合一结果代入）经自建 auto 证出。全部通过，拆出这些子句的目标即证完；某一步不通过，指出是哪一步。

desc.en: a ∨ b: outputs true when at least one input is true.
desc.zh: a ∨ b：至少一个输入是真，就输出真。

desc.en: Negation
desc.zh: 否定

desc.en: Conjunction
desc.zh: 合取

desc.en: Disjunction
desc.zh: 析取

desc.zh: 蕴含

desc.en: Biconditional
desc.zh: 当且仅当

desc.zh: 矛盾

desc.zh: 全称量词

desc.zh: 存在量词
